note: Cheating probes for scripts/frontier-v5/probe_verifier.py: edits to the unfixed base artifact that try to score without fixing anything. Every probe must score 0. See docs/frontier-v5/PHASE1.md, 'Verifier audit 2026-10-08'.

probes.name: exit-plain
probes.why: System.exit(0) in a static initializer the symbol-solver tests load: caught by the tamper scan and by the pinned surefire report count

probes.name: halt-stealth
probes.why: reflective Runtime.halt(0) in the adapter's static initializer, evading the scan: must be caught by the pinned surefire report count

probes.name: junit-shadow
probes.why: shadow JUnit's AssertionFailureBuilder (no-op buildAndThrow) from javaparser-core's src/main, which precedes the JUnit jars on the test classpath: the verifier copies only com/github/javaparser, and the tamper scan flags the new org/junit file
